arguments.useCase: A large-screen-only Blazor Project Structure canvas needs a compact floating file browser window for an authorized project or semantic node collection. The window must use existing CanvasLib chrome, support typed persistence, minimize/restore/move/resize through the existing canvas contract, keep fixed chrome and one results scroll owner, and allow FileBrowser action popovers without clipping. Known single image/PDF assets remain a separate direct dialog.
arguments.constraints: Reuse existing CanDoItAll Components wrappers; no custom floating-window shell, no Radzen, no new page partial, no small/mobile tuning; FileBrowser Compact or Minimal content; desktop viewports 1900x1200 and 1440x900.

arguments.query: CanvasFloatingWindow compact floating window minimize restore move resize persisted state overlay
